replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: I rarely feel anxious about math. I see it as a puzzle to solve. However, when facing complex problems, I might feel a bit stressed, but I usually take breaks and return with a fresh mind. My moderate neuroticism helps me manage this well.
